questions.stem: What is a key difference between xylem and phloem?

options.text: Xylem cells are dead; phloem cells are living
Xylem cells have a nucleus; phloem cells do not
Xylem can transport in both directions; phloem only upwards
Xylem transports sugars; phloem transports water

questions.explanation: Xylem vessels are made of dead cells with no cytoplasm or end walls, allowing unobstructed water flow. Phloem sieve tube elements are living cells (though they lose their nucleus when mature) because translocation is an active process.
